job.title: Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform (m/w/d)
job.location: Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tailoring.headline: Engineering / Technical Delivery: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: ALDI SÜD's massive scale and digital commerce evolution make leading platforms here an inspiring challenge. With over 5 years of hands-on technical delivery in enterprise e-commerce at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in building, scaling, and integrating SAP Commerce Cloud solutions.

bullets.label: Platform Engineering
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, adhering to platform best practices and robust design patterns.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and engineered API migrations for customer account structures, improving system stability and data consistency across global channels.

bullets.label: Data & Pipeline Delivery
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across enterprise e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: DevOps & Quality
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, supported by automated unit and integration test suites.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical leadership and platform expertise can support ALDI SÜD.

tailoring.why_company: ALDI SÜD operates at an incredible scale, transforming global retail through robust digital commerce platforms. Contributing to such high-impact e-commerce engineering, ensuring resilient backend architectures, and driving seamless platform integrations is the exact challenge I want to tackle next.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, robust Java/Spring engineering, and end-to-end platform delivery to scale ALDI SÜD's e-commerce landscape.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building and scaling enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep Java, API, and platform integration expertise to ALDI SÜD. My CV and cover letter are attached. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for the Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform position at ALDI SÜD. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building and scaling enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, REST APIs, and complex platform integrations.

I look forward to discussing how my technical background can support your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
